narr: Multiple rounds of showers and storms affected the region from the afternoon of the 15th to the morning of the 18th as a slow moving front interacted with several upper level disturbances. While instability and moisture were near to below seasonal normals, training of storms over already saturated areas led to localized flooding of low water crossings. Flooding mainly occurred during the 16th and 17th.
ev: Portions of Commercial and Kearney Streets in downtown had at least 12 inches of running water over them after 2.27 inches of rain fell in 45 minutes.

Numerous intersections in the mid town area of Springfield flooded. Manhole covers were popped off by water along Jefferson Street south of Chestnut Expressway. Two water rescues were performed as vehicles drove into flooded low water areas.
